pages.title: A Dressed Defender
pages.text: Equip your Great Pyrenees with its protective vest and successfully feed a pet appropriate food.

pages.title: A Dressed Defender
pages.text: Kibble and two bowls maintain the protected yard companion without granting a free new dog.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Sneak-use the vest on your owned dog. Pet Kibble heals Manx Cats or Great Pyrenees; species diets differ. Do not injure a pet deliberately; accepted ordinary feeding also qualifies.

pages.title: Serve food in a pet bowl
pages.text: Put suitable Cat Food or Dog Food into the bowl. A Name Tag customizes it; sneak-right-click opens its settings and Shears recover the tag.

pages.title: Choose species-specific animal feed
pages.text: Cat Food, Dog Food, Horse Fodder and Chicken Feed serve different animals. Their tooltips describe taming, combat, running or jumping, and egg or feather production; there is no universal feed.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use pet kibble on Manx Cats or Great Pyrenees. The native tooltip identifies kibble as pet healing food.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Sneak and use the protective vest on a Great Pyrenees. The dog receives its native protective equipment.
